parse_memcached_bench_results: parse memcached benchmark stdout to extract server hit latency and client QPS metrics
extract_server_hit_latency: extract the server hit latency in microseconds from memcached bench output lines starting with items
extract_client_qps_metrics: extract client QPS including sets, gets, hits, and misses from memcached bench output
calculate_hit_ratio: calculate the cache hit ratio by dividing QPS hits by total QPS from memcached bench results
review_MemcachedBenchParser_parse: review the MemcachedBenchParser parse method to understand how it extracts server and client metrics from stdout
